create_setup_instance: create a Setup instance that builds a Vocab and Dataset from filepaths for the path_trans model
convert_tokens_with_vocab: convert dependency paths, extensions, and root paths into vocabulary indices using the Vocab convert method
collate_batch_sequences: collate a batch of sequences into padded PyTorch tensors with input, target, and root path data
pad_root_paths: pad root paths to uniform length within a batch using the combine_root_paths helper function
build_dataset_for_training: build a Dataset instance from a file path and IDs file for path-based code prediction training
